request.description: The body of every call: the operation's arguments and the request options.
request.title: RequestEnvelope

DryRunReport.description: The outcome of a dry run: nothing was changed, journaled or recorded.
DryRunReport.title: DryRunReport

operations.name: couplings.import
operations.summary: Replace the couplings with a CSV's, under a label mapping the caller confirmed (stable IDs kept).

operations.name: couplings.reconcile
operations.summary: Read a couplings CSV against the project: the proposed label mapping and the diff (no change).

operations.name: fit.preview
operations.summary: Preview the fit at a fixed torsion: order parameters re-solved, predictions and residuals.

operations.name: fit.run
operations.revision_check: expected_science_revision (required): the job computes from that state
operations.summary: Submit the D3 fit of the current project as a job (estimates, validity, adequacy, and optional profile intervals under the reporting policy). Returns the job at once; read the run with job.wait and run.get.

operations.name: history.log
operations.summary: The science changes that can be undone and redone, the next first.

operations.name: history.redo
operations.summary: Redo the latest undone science change (a new, journaled command).

operations.name: history.undo
operations.summary: Undo the latest science change (a new, journaled command).

operations.name: job.cancel
operations.summary: Cancel an unfinished job (a propose-tier caller: its own jobs only). A finished job is left as it is.

operations.name: job.list
operations.summary: The session's jobs (unfinished, and the latest finished).

operations.name: job.status
operations.summary: One job: its status, input identity, run or error, and whether its input is stale.

operations.name: job.wait
operations.summary: Wait until a job finishes, at most timeout_s (≤ 30 s); call again if it has not.

operations.name: model.set
operations.summary: Set the model: kind (rigid, jump4), order model, frame and torsion domain.

operations.name: molecule.set_torsion
operations.summary: Declare the fitted torsion of imported geometry: four atom indices (a, i, j, b), i–j a bond.

operations.name: project.describe
operations.summary: Describe the project: geometry, spins, couplings, model, estimand and readiness to fit, with IDs.

operations.name: project.export
operations.summary: The project as *.dipolar.json text, with a suggested file name.

operations.name: project.import_xyz
operations.summary: Replace the project with one on imported XYZ coordinates (one spin per hydrogen, no couplings).

operations.name: project.load
operations.summary: Replace the project with a *.dipolar.json document (validated and migrated).

operations.name: project.open_example
operations.summary: Replace the session's project with a bundled example dataset.

operations.name: proposal.accept
operations.revision_check: the proposal's base science revision must be current (else PROPOSAL_STALE)
operations.summary: Accept a pending proposal (human only): all steps, or a dependency-closed subset, applied atomically as one transaction.

operations.name: proposal.create
operations.revision_check: each step's own expected_science_revision: step i expects base + i
operations.summary: Submit proposable commands as one change set for a human to accept; validated against the current state, nothing is applied.

operations.name: proposal.get
operations.summary: One proposal with every step's arguments.

operations.name: proposal.list
operations.summary: The session's proposals (pending, and the latest decided), without their arguments.

operations.name: proposal.reject
operations.summary: Reject a pending proposal (human only), with an optional reason.

operations.name: render.describe_view
operations.summary: Describe the shared view: revisions, the run it reflects and whether it is stale, visible objects, selection, highlights, the largest residuals and warnings.

operations.name: render.scene
operations.summary: The scene description (04 §8.4): atoms with coordinates and projected screen positions, bonds, couplings with residuals, camera, layers, selection and highlights.

operations.name: render.view_svg
operations.summary: The shared view as an SVG, rendered on the server from the scene description.

operations.name: run.get
operations.summary: A run's result (the fit), verified against its stored hash, and whether it is stale.

operations.name: run.list
operations.summary: The session's runs, newest first, each with its input identity and staleness.

operations.name: view.highlight
operations.revision_check: none: an absolute set of view state; never touches the science
operations.summary: Set the shared highlights to the given spin or coupling IDs (replaces them).

operations.name: view.select
operations.revision_check: none: an absolute set; IDs are validated atomically and never reused
operations.summary: Set the shared selection to the given spin or coupling IDs (replaces it).

operations.name: view.set_camera
operations.revision_check: none: an absolute set of view state; never touches the science
operations.summary: Set the shared camera (a perspective camera in Å) and viewport; camera null fits the molecule automatically.

operations.name: view.set_layers
operations.revision_check: none: an absolute set of view state; never touches the science
operations.summary: Show or hide the labels, bonds and coupling lines of the shared view.
